hi.solution: 31 December 2003 was the last day in 2003 and 2004 was the leap year which means 2004 had 366 days. Jan had 31 days, Feb has 28 days, and from 1st march to 7th march total days = 7 Hence, total days from 1 Jan 2004 to 7 Mar 2005 = 366 + 31 + 28 + 7 = 432 days = 61 weeks and 5 days. Since, 30 Dec 2003 was a Wednesday which means 7 Mar 2005 was 5th days after Thursday. 5th day after Wednesday is Monday. Hence, 7 March 2005 was a Monday.

hi.solution: We know that, each clock is composed on 360° that is divided into 12 equal regions. So, the angle between the consecutive divisions is obtained by dividing the total angle of clock 360° by the number of divisions i.e. 12. Thus, the angle between any two consecutive divisions = (360°)/12= 30°. In other words, the angle formed by an hour hand in 1 hour = 30° and the angle formed by an hour hand in 30 minutes = 30°/2 = 15°. From 5pm to 9:30 pm, total number of hours = 4 hours 30 minutes. So, angle = 4*30° + 15° = 120° + 15° = 135°.

hi.solution: • As we know that the year which are multiples of 4 are the leap year. Among the century years, only the multiples of 400 are leap years. • 1 October 2020 means 2019 years and days from January 1, 2020 to October 1, 2020. • Odd no. of days in first 1600 years is 0. • Odd number days in 400 years is 0 • From 2001 to 2019 there are fifteen ordinary years and 4 leap years. • Hence, Odd no. of Days = 15 + (4 X 2) = 15 + 8 = 23 (3 weeks and 2 days) = 2 odd days. • No. of days from January 1, 2020 to October 1, 2020= 31+29+31+30+31+30+31+31+30+1 = 275 days (which is 39 weeks and 2 days) = 2 odd days. • Total odd days = 0+2+2 = 4 • 4 odd days means Thursday.

prompt: वियान की जन्म तिथि 9 मार्च 2002 है। इस तारीख के सप्ताह का दिन ज्ञात कीजिए।
hi.solution: It is given that, The birth date of Viaan is 9 March 2002. We know, odd days in the first 2000 years = 0. Odd days in the year 2001 = 1. The number of days from 1 January 2002 to 9 March 2002 = 31 + 28 + 9 = 68. Odd days in the year 2002 (till 9 March 2002) = 5 (68 days = 9 weeks and 5 days). Total odd days = 1 + 5 = 6. Hence, the day was Saturday.

prompt: यदि 12 फरवरी 1932 को शुक्रवार था, तो 12 फरवरी 2025 को सप्ताह का कौन सा दिन होगा?
hi.solution: 12th February 1932 was Friday. Period starting from 12th February 1932 to 12th February 2025, there were 94 years. If we divide 94 by 4 (because leap year occurs in every 4 years), then the quotient will be 23. So, from period of 12th February 1932 to 12th February 2025, there were 23 leap years and 71 normal years. We know that, there are 2 odd days in a leap year and 1 odd day in a normal year. Thus, 23 * 2 + 71 * 1 = 46 + 71 = 117 odd days. If we divide, 117 by 7, then remainder will be 5. So, 5 odd days. So, 12th February 2025 = Friday + 5 days = Wednesday.

prompt: If 12th February 1932 was Friday, then what day of a week will fall on 12th February 2025?

Thus, 23 * 2 + 71 * 1 = 46 + 71 = 117 odd days. If we divide, 117 by 7, then remainder will be 5. So, 5 odd days. So, 12th February 2025 = Friday + 5 days = Wednesday.

hi.solution: W is two and half times as tall as X and O is three-fourth as tall as W. W = 2.5X, O = 3W/4 = 0.75W .. (i) T and X together are as tall as W. T + X = W .. Therefore, after m minutes past 8:00, the position of the hour hand will be: Hour hand position= 240+0.5m Position of the minute hand: The minute hand starts at 0 degrees at 8:00 and moves at a rate of 6 degrees per minute (since it moves 360 degrees in 60 minutes). एक निश्चित कोड भाषा में,
'A x B' का अर्थ है 'A, B का पुत्र है',
'A - B' का अर्थ है 'A, B का भाई है',
'A + B' का अर्थ है 'A, B की पत्नी है',
'A % B' का अर्थ है 'A, B का पिता है'।
यदि 'M x N + P - S % T' है तो M, T से किस प्रकार संबंधित है?
hi.solution: M x N: M is the son of N N + P: N is the wife of P P - S: P is the brother of S S % T: S is the father of T So, M is the Father's brother's son of T. Thus, option (d) is the correct answer.

hi.solution: 6th August 1601 means 1600 years and days from January 1, 1601 to August, 6, 1601. Odd no. of days in first 1600 years is 0 (Odd days in 1600 years - 0 and odd days in 400 years - 0). No. of Days from January 1, 1601 to August, 6, 1601 = 31 + 28 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 6 = 218 (which is 31 weeks and 1 day). Hence, there is 1 odd day from January 1, 1601 to August, 6, 1601. Total odd days = 0 + 1 = 1, which is 1 odd day. Hence, it was a Monday on 6th August 1601.

prompt: 14 मार्च 2010 को सप्ताह का कौन सा दिन था?
hi.solution: Suppose today is 22 August 2023 and day is Tuesday. (We need to take the current date and current day). Now, we calculate the total number of days from 14 March 2010 to 22 August 2023. Total days from 14 March 2010 to 22 August 2023 = Total days from 14 March 2010 to 14 March 2023 + Total days from 14 March 2023 to 22 August 2023 Total days from 14 March 2010 to 14 March 2023 = 13 * 365 + 3 (Leap years) = 4745 + 3 = 4748 days Total days from 14 March 2023 to 22 August 2023 = 31 (March) + 30 (April) + 31 (May) + 30 (June) + 31 (July) + 8 (Remaining days in August) = 161 days Total days from 14 March 2010 to 22 August 2023 = 4748 + 161 = 4909 days = 701 weeks 2 days So, the day on 22 August 2023 will be 2 days ahead of the day on 14 March 2010. Hence, the day on 14 March 2010 was Sunday.

hi.solution: If the total number of odd days between any two years is zero or a multiple of seven, then the two years will have the exact same calendar. No. of odd days in each leap year = 2 and in each other year = 1 So, for each of 2022, 2023, 2025, 2026, 2027, 2029, 2030, 2031, 2033 we will get 1 odd day, hence, total = 9 odd days. For each of 2024, 2028 and 2032, we will get 2 odd days, hence, total =6 Thus 2022 to 2033 has 15 odd days, i.e., 14 + 1 odd days We need 6 more odd days to have the same calendar. Again, for 2034, 2035, we have 2 odd days. So, 2035 will not have the same calendar. Till 2035, we have 3 odd days, we need 4 more to have the same calendar. For 2036, 2037, we get 3 odd days as 2036 is a leap year. So, till 2037, we get 6 odd days. For 2038, we have one more odd day and the total becomes 7 odd days. So, 2039 will have the have the same calendar. (2041 will not as 3 more odd days will add up).

prompt: यदि 14 जनवरी 2022 को शुक्रवार था, तो 28 फरवरी 2025 को सप्ताह का कौन-सा दिन होगा?
hi.solution: The number of days between 14 January 2022 and 14 January 2025 = 365 + 365 + 366 (as 2024 is a leap year) = 1096. The number of days between 14 January 2025 and 28 February 2025 = 17 (in January) + 28 (in February) = 45. Total number of days = 1096 + 45 = 1141. Each day is repeated after 7 days. 1141/7 = 163. Hence, it will be a Friday on 28 February 2025 which is exactly 163 weeks after 14 January 2022.

prompt: If 14 January 2022 was Friday, then what will be the day of the week on 28 February 2025?

The number of days between 14 January 2025 and 28 February 2025 = 17 (in January) + 28 (in February) = 45. Total number of days = 1096 + 45 = 1141. Each day is repeated after 7 days. 1141/7 = 163. Hence, it will be a Friday on 28 February 2025 which is exactly 163 weeks after 14 January 2022.

prompt: यदि कल सोमवार था, तो आज से 45वें दिन कौन सा दिन होगा?
hi.solution: Yesterday it was Monday Then today it is Tuesday. Days repeat after every 7 days. 45 ÷ 7 Nearest multiple of 7 is 42 Remainder = 45 - 42 = 3 Odd days = 3 Tuesday + 3 = Friday Thus, after the 45th day, it will be Friday.
